Discord PowerTools

A customizable workspace for the Discord website.

v1.6.0 · Public source · Browser userscript

A browser userscript for Discord with 17 dashboard tabs: workspace profiles, favorite channels, local notes and bookmarks, media tools, focus layouts, Theme Studio, and diagnostics. Runs on the Discord website with a userscript manager; desktop Discord is not supported.

Get the script on GitHubRelease notes

Your Discord workspace

  • Workspace profiles, per-server workspaces, favorites, and navigation history.
  • Local notes, message bookmarks, copy tools, and media inspection.
  • Focus layouts, focus/break timer, and local notification display controls.
  • Theme Studio, performance settings, diagnostics, and safe mode.
  • Keyboard navigation across all 17 tabs.

Install from source

  1. Install a userscript manager such as Tampermonkey or Violentmonkey.
  2. Open the repository and install the complete Discord-PowerTools.user.js file through your manager.
  3. Reload discord.com and click the Purple Dragon launcher.
  4. Disable duplicate older copies when updating.

No Node.js build is needed to use the script. The repository prepares it for Greasy Fork distribution; publication there is not confirmed.

Local records and clear limits

Settings, notes, bookmarks, and saved message text live in your userscript manager, with local storage used for recovery when needed. They are not separated by Discord account within the same browser profile. Keep exported snapshots private.

Smart Search searches locally saved PowerTools records. Cosmetic previews are local. The script does not grant Nitro, extract tokens, or automate self-bot messaging.

Compatibility

Supports discord.com, ptb.discord.com, and canary.discord.com. Discord interface changes may affect selectors. Performance options are tuning choices rather than guaranteed speed improvements. The desktop application is not supported.

Snapshot exports support inspection and manual recovery; there is no automatic import/restore interface.
